description: 【和歌山県】異常気象時の道路規制 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 和歌山県. 和歌山県管理道路において異常気象時に事前通行規制を行う区間の情報を提供しています。 異常気象時通行規制区間とは、豪雨・台風・高波等の異常気象時において事前に通行止めを行う区間であり、通行規制情報とは異なります。. Coverage: 和歌山県. The portal files it under the publisher 和歌山県. Its tags are マップ, 地図, 安全, 災害, 異常気象. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv, geojson, html, kml, zip. The portal shows 2022-10-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
